analysis:
META fell 4.1%, roughly in line with the market's 4.4% drop and tracking its mega-cap tech peers, which posted a median decline of 2.9%. The stock fell 1.2 percentage points more than that peer median but 2.2 points less than the QQQ benchmark, suggesting a theme-driven selloff rather than a company-specific issue. Headlines point to broad AI and tech sector concerns, with The Wall Street Journal reporting "AI Panic Grips Stocks" and TIKR noting worries about social ad demand as Reddit also declined sharply, though none of the six items provide article text beyond their titles.

META reports earnings on January 27, 83 days out. Recent history shows large moves around its reports — a median absolute abnormal move of 10.3% beyond what the market explains — but beating estimates has not been reliable, with two of the last seven beats still producing negative abnormal reactions, including a 10.3-point lag in April 2026 despite a 7.2% beat and a 9.7-point drop last October after an 8.7% beat.
